text: The thousand-year-old church that archaeologists have excavated at Hrísbrú could very well be the church that is mentioned in Egils Saga as having been built by Grímr Svertingsson. The church is about 6 meters long and 3 meters wide. This excavation sheds new light on church construction techniques in the Nordic countries from the times of the Vikings. The archaeologists think that the church at Hrísbrú should be rebuilt because it is one of the few archaeological cases that include such detailed information about construction techniques, making it an excellent opportunity to build a reconstruction.
